# redpanda_cloud_provider_access (Resource)

A Redpanda Cloud cross-account cloud provider access configuration



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider for this access configuration. Currently only `aws` is supported.
- `name` (String) Display name for the cloud provider access configuration.

### Optional

- `aws` (Attributes) AWS-specific configuration for the cross-account IAM role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws))
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the cloud provider access configuration.
- `state` (String) Current state of the configuration (e.g. PENDING, ACTIVE, FAILED).

<a id="nestedatt--aws"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aws`

Required:

- `role_arn` (String) The full ARN of the customer IAM role that Redpanda will assume for cross-account provisioning.

Read-Only:

- `external_id` (String) External ID for the IAM trust policy's sts:ExternalId condition. Derived from the organization ID by the server.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
